notes.subject: nĩarũarwo
notes.rationale: מחלל: 'kũhinyĩrwo/kũruarwo' (pierced) handĩrĩ 'kũarũarwo' (wounded) — YLT na BSB ciatũra 'pierced', KJV 'wounded'.

notes.subject: tha
notes.rationale: שלום nĩ ũhoro mũingĩ kũnga 'tha wiki' — kwao kũgima, thayũ, na hinya.

notes.subject: mathina
notes.rationale: חבורה nĩ gĩcunjĩ kĩa mwĩrĩ kĩrĩa kĩnyitithanĩte na mahũa — 'mathina' nĩ mũhiano wa kũgera kũrĩa kũingĩ.

notes.subject: ithuĩ
notes.rationale: לנו nyiitĩtwo na ithuĩ cuma kana thutha wa riĩtwa rĩa kĩngima, nĩgeetha kĩngima kĩoneke thĩinĩ wa mũhuro ⟨ithuĩ⟩.

translation: Na ithuĩ nĩarũarwo nĩ njambo cia ithuĩ, aguũngĩrwo nĩ mbia cia ithuĩ; kĩrũme kĩa tha cia ithuĩ kĩrĩ igũrũ rĩake, na mathina makĩmake nĩagĩtwo ⟨ithuĩ⟩.
